blocks.text: Liquids aur solids ka farq saaf hai aur un ke darmiyan phase transition hamesha saaf muqarrar. Magar kuch darja hararat par bohat se madde aise phase mein maujood hote hain jo na poora liquid hai na poora solid: un ke molecules viscous liquids ki tarah harkat kar sakte hain, magar solids ki tarah harkat ki mehdood had rakhte hain. Yeh madde liquid crystals kehlate hain. Garam karne par crystalline solid dhundla liquid banta hai, liquid crystal, aur phir saaf liquid. Zyada tar liquid crystals mein molecules ki sakht, chhari jaisi shakal hoti hai jis ki lambai qutr se chaar se aath guna hai; ek saath bhare hone par molecules apne lambe mehwar taqreeban mutawazi rakhne ka rujhan rakhte hain, jaise lakrion ke dher mein lakriyan. Alag molecules liquid mein safar kar sakte hain aur apne lambe mehwar ke gird ghoom sakte hain, magar sire se sire tak palat nahi sakte.

blocks.prompt: Liquid crystal kis tarah liquid se milta hai, aur kis tarah crystalline solid se?
blocks.explanation: Liquid ki tarah us ke molecules harkat kar sakte hain aur madda behta hai. Crystal ki tarah molecules ba-tarteeb tarteeb rakhte hain, un ke lambe mehwar taqreeban mutawazi, aur woh sire se sire tak palat nahi sakte, to un ki harkat mehdood hai.

items: Liquid crystals: solid aur liquid ke darmiyan ka phase (crystal, phir dhundla liquid crystal, phir saaf liquid) sakht chhari-numa molecules ka, chaurai se chaar se aath guna lambe, taqreeban mutawazi lete hue; woh safar aur apne lambe mehwar par ghoomte hain magar palat nahi sakte.
